procedure.purpose: take released finished goods into stock under warehouse responsibility so that the stock record agrees with what has physically arrived and the goods can be committed to delivery

trigger.text: finished goods expected for stocking are awaiting warehouse receipt and physical intake

steps.businessAction: begin warehouse intake by taking physical custody of the released goods
check what physically arrived against what production confirmed as completed
put the accepted goods into their stock location
record the stock movement and the stock state that results from it
